name: Support Ticket Classification
description: 1,200 English customer-support tickets for a company selling a SaaS app and shipped smart-home hardware, each routed to one of 8 queues: billing, technical issue, account access, shipping, returns/refunds, product inquiry, cancellation or feature request.
task: Which support queue should handle this customer ticket?

labels.name: billing
labels.description: Money already charged or owed on an existing account or order: charges, invoices and receipts, payment methods and failed payments, billing contact, price changes on a current plan, and duplicate, unexpected or incorrect charges — including asking for money back for a wrong charge, even one made after a cancellation or downgrade, or a wrong shipping fee. A refund for an item that was physically sent back is returns_refunds; pre-sales pricing questions are product_inquiry.

labels.name: technical_issue
labels.description: Something in the app, API, an integration or a device is malfunctioning and the customer wants it fixed: bugs, error messages, crashes, sync or connectivity failures, failed firmware updates, slow performance. Problems signing in (password, 2FA, lockout) are account_access even when an error appears; wanting to send a faulty device back is returns_refunds; asking for functionality that does not exist is feature_request.

labels.name: account_access
labels.description: Getting into or securing an account: login failures, password resets, two-factor authentication, locked or compromised accounts, recovering access, changing the login email or username, and granting or revoking a person's login/admin access. Changing where invoices are sent is billing; closing or deleting the account is cancellation.

labels.name: shipping_delivery
labels.description: Status or delivery of an order that has not been (fully) received: processing, dispatch, tracking, delays, carrier questions, changing the delivery address or date, and packages that are lost, missing, misdelivered or sent back as undeliverable. Once an item has been received and is damaged, wrong or unwanted it is returns_refunds; a dispute about a shipping fee charged is billing.

labels.name: returns_refunds
labels.description: A physical product the customer has received: returning or exchanging it (unwanted, defective, wrong size/colour), items that arrived damaged, incomplete or different from what was ordered, return labels and return policy, and the status of the refund for an item that was sent back. Money back for a wrong charge with no item returned is billing; a package never received is shipping_delivery.

labels.name: product_inquiry
labels.description: Pre-sales or informational questions about what is offered: hardware specs and features, compatibility, stock and availability, warranty, plans, plan comparison and list prices, trials and discounts. Asking whether something already exists is product_inquiry; asking for it to be built is feature_request; questions about a charge already made are billing.

labels.name: cancellation
labels.description: Ending or reducing a subscription or account: cancelling a subscription, plan or add-on, stopping auto-renewal, downgrading to a cheaper or free plan, ending a trial before it converts, closing or deleting an account. If the main ask is money back for a charge that already happened it is billing; returning hardware is returns_refunds.

labels.name: feature_request
labels.description: Suggestions or requests for functionality, integrations, compatibility or hardware improvements that do not exist today — including improvements to billing, login, tracking or subscription flows. Broken existing functionality is technical_issue; merely asking whether something exists is product_inquiry.
